items.question: What distinct goal do akula-heroes pursue in contrast to all others who desire liberation?
premises: Akula-heroes are set in contrast to them.
Akula-heroes desire the giver of liberation.
items.inference: The akula-heroes seek the source of liberation rather than liberation itself.
uncertainties: The exact referent of mokṣadam (a deity, guru, or principle) is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: All of them desire liberation, but the akula-heroes desire the giver of liberation.
